mean_removal_convention.emission_space_129d: mean-removed by mu = the mean of the FULL 19,390-entry bank (C0/C1/C5 convention). RAW cosines reported alongside wherever C1-final's own registered number is raw.
mean_removal_convention.latent_space_200d: mean-removed by the mean over the TRAINING states of the split being evaluated -- NOT over all 72, so no held-out state's input enters the predictor's own centring.

knn_design.predictor: profile_hat(s) = sum_j softmax(-d(s,j)/h) * profile(j) over the k nearest TRAINING states j; then C5's blend rule (top-5, weights the normalised positive part) turns the predicted profile into an emission
knn_design.bandwidth: h = m * median(train-train distance), m over 25 log-spaced multipliers in [1e-2, 1e1]; chosen by LEAVE-ONE-OUT SPEARMAN WITHIN THE TRAINING STATES ONLY. k=1 makes h inert and reports h=None.

distances.latent: 1 - cos in the 200-d cohort-mean latent, centred on the TRAIN mean
distances.tree: the tree-path distance d(i)+d(j)-2*depth(LCA), banked by C5
distances.both: the sum of the two, each z-scored on the TRAIN x TRAIN off-diagonal

knn_design.selection_rule: the headline arm is the (distance, k) whose LOO-within-train Spearman is highest -- chosen before any held-out state is scored

selected_arm.selected_by: highest LOO Spearman WITHIN the training states

common_vs_residual.definition: for each state, decompose its MEAN-REMOVED target t into the component along the LOO mean of the OTHER 71 mean-removed targets (the COMMON direction) and the orthogonal STATE-SPECIFIC residual. The norm fraction is |cos| (C5's D3 number); the ENERGY fraction is cos^2 and is the one to quote.
common_vs_residual.headline: the common component carries 0.4085 of a target's mean-removed ENERGY; the state-specific residual carries 0.5915
